# Hash-pinned dependency set for the astropy (ERFA/SOFA) differential sweep.
#
# Installed in CI with `pip install --require-hashes -r`, so every wheel is
# verified against a recorded SHA-256 before it runs. Pinning astropy-iers-data
# alongside astropy also keeps the 100,000-epoch sweep reproducible: the
# reference leap-second table cannot change underneath a re-run.
#
# Regenerate after changing the astropy pin:
#   uv pip compile scripts/requirements-differential.in --generate-hashes \
#     --python-version 3.12 --python-platform linux --no-header \
#     -o scripts/requirements-differential.txt
